learning_goals: connect optimisation to equilibrium and numerical relaxation
recognise momentum, stochastic, adaptive, Newton, and quasi-Newton methods
target_depth: Conceptual and computational introduction with selected theorem statements and worked calculations
proof_depth: Interpret theorem conditions and explain their role; no full proofs
assumptions_requiring_review: Analogy with potential energy is pedagogical: not every objective is physical energy and iterations are not automatically physical time evolution.
Convergence claims apply only under their stated smoothness, convexity, initialization, and algorithm conditions.
